description: This file defines custom callback handlers for the LiteLLM Proxy, including a subclass of CustomLogger with methods for logging various events and an instance of this handler. It is used for testing and customization of log callbacks within the LiteLLM framework.

classes.name: MyCustomHandler
classes.description: A custom logger class inheriting from CustomLogger, implementing logging methods for different API events.

methods.name: print_verbose(print_statement)
methods.description: Function to print debugging information if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializes the custom logger, displays methods, and sets up color codes.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.log_pre_api_call
methods.description: Logs information before an API call is made.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.log_post_api_call
methods.description: Logs information after an API call is completed.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.log_stream_event
methods.description: Logs streaming events during API communication.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful API response event.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronous logging for a successful event, calculating completion cost.

methods.name: MyCustomHandler.async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronous logging for a failure event, with exception handling.
